shared_elements: low-relief carved surface with repeated/organized motifs
possible human-head forms (glyph faces in A, profile heads in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear carved relief motifs organized into a regular scheme, and both may include human faces (as tiny elements inside A's glyph blocks, as large profile heads in B). Otherwise A is a dense vertical column of rectangular sign-blocks with no scene, while B is a figural tableau of two large standing figures facing one another, holding objects and gesturing — different subject matter, relationships and layout entirely.
